title: Personal Credit Cards: Points Available to a Statement Credit
content:
This page of the Personal Credit Cards rewards terms says which points a statement credit against the card may draw on.

## Counting the points

The points on the card are counted from the card's own ledger when the matter is handled: every point the card has been credited for purchases, less every point used by earlier redemptions, less every point removed from the card through forfeiture or through a clawback after a merchant refund.

## What the pool never contains

Points that this charter directs to some other redemption from the same card are never part of the pool a statement credit draws on.

## Worked example (hypothetical entries)

| Ledger entries | Points |
|---|---|
| Credited for purchases | 30210 |
| Used by earlier redemptions | 7500 |
| Removed after refunds | 610 |
| Pool at handling time | 22100 |
